title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

title: Straight Outta Fishtown
overview: Upon his release from prison, rapper RONG WU finds himself hailed as the new icon of hip-hop after a pre-prison freestyle unexpectedly goes viral. Wanting nothing more than to leave his past behind, he seeks refuge in a remote fishing village with his old friend GUANG, who invites him to perform at the local carnival. There, RONG discovers the raw rap talent of GUANG’s daughter, FISH, and gradually reclaims his passion for music and life. But when his past resurfaces, RONG must choose between living up to the world’s expectations and staying true to himself.

title: The Tunnel Curse
overview: Located in Taipei, the Xinhai Tunnel connects the bustling Da’an District with the culturally rich Wenshan District. However, due to its proximity to a funeral home and cemetery, it has earned the infamous title of ‘Most Haunted Road,’ with ghost stories emerging from every corner. Among the chilling tales, the most well-known are the eerie ‘Ghost Wall’ encounters. Stories include taxi drivers who unknowingly pick up ghostly passengers and are unable to exit the tunnel, and motorcyclists who, after seeing a long-haired woman by the roadside, find themselves trapped in the tunnel. Often referred to as the ‘Tunnel of the Dead,’ it has become one of Taiwan’s most famous urban legends. After years of research and preparation, the haunting story of the Xinhai Tunnel is finally being brought to the screen, revealing the chilling origins behind its supernatural phenomena.

title: Jumanji: Open World
overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure
overview: The emperor gives Jinshi an order: He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they're in pristine condition. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away. On the day of the concubine's funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.
